Subject: Private/VPC readiness assessment — Midwest Medical discovery recap & next steps

Laura / Mike — thanks again for the 30-minute call today. Below is a concise recap of what I heard, our alignment on success criteria, and proposed next steps so we can keep momentum toward a private/VPC deployment conversation. Please flag anything I missed or mis-stated.

Key customer pain points (as discussed)
- PHI-sensitive inference; cannot route requests through multi-tenant public endpoints.
- Current inference latency is unpredictable and occasionally violates internal SLOs for clinician workflows.
- Cost and predictability: they need committed capacity for peak hours and predictable monthly costs.

Current stack & constraints
- On-prem VMs + private cloud for EHR integration (Epic).
- Primary workflows: discharge note summarization, clinical decision support prompts at point-of-care.
- Network: outbound-only egress is strongly preferred; certain air-gap windows for batch model updates.
- Security: customer-managed keys (HSM/KMS) requirement for model encryption at rest; SOC 2 and documented pen-test evidence needed.

Success criteria for a pilot/POC
1) Private deployment (VPC or on-prem) that keeps PHI in their network.
2) Latency below 250ms P50 for short clinical prompts in the pilot config.
3) Demonstrable KMS/HSM integration with customer key control.
4) Clear deployment runbook and network topology template so hospital security can review.

Open questions we committed to answer
- Can Redwood run in a true air-gapped mode for periodic offline model updates? (we will confirm technical constraints and operational cadence)
- Exact network ports and allowed IP ranges for the Dedicated connector and control-plane endpoints.
- Specific SOC 2 artifacts they need for procurement.

Next steps (proposed timeline)
- By Tue Mar 3: share a "Private Deployment Readiness" checklist + network topology template (attached).
- By Wed Mar 4: Marissa to run a short technical deep-dive with their infra team (30–45m).
- By Fri Mar 6: Rishi to share an initial pricing and reserved capacity estimate (POC-sized commit).
- Schedule: suggest Mar 9–11 for the technical deep-dive — please confirm best times.

Attachments I am sending with this note: redwood-private-readiness-checklist.xlsx, network-topology-template.docx, SOC2 summary (soc2-summary.pdf).

Thanks — looking forward to next steps.

—
Dev Patel | Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference

- Network: I need to confirm if their environment allows a small outbound-only control channel; if not, we will propose a facilitated transfer process. Please ask Mike if their security team prefers an outbound-only connector or a strict no-egress policy during the pilot.
- PoC scope suggestion: 1) inference-only endpoint for a single clinical workflow, 2) RW instance in their VPC with customer-managed keys, 3) scripted model update flow (documented offline process if they insist on air-gap).

Tech questions for customer (please relay to Mike/Laura):
